integrity: The proof independently starts from the published vertex layers, proves uniqueness and symmetry of the circumcenter, reduces the problem to a one-dimensional maximum of explicit quadratics, solves the active-layer transition exactly through the strictly decreasing D_k statistic, and derives the classical golden-ratio threshold. Finite computation is used only as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the canonical two-parameter parking-function-polytope realization with n>=2 and positive integer a,b. It does not give a formula for the full arbitrary-parameter-vector family, affine-invariant radii, or John ellipsoids. A residual originality risk remains for a general minimum-enclosing-ball theorem for symmetric polymatroids or generalized permutahedra.
title: Exact circumspheres of two-parameter parking-function polytopes
